data.welcomeMessage: Welcome to the ASTU Alumni Management System, a digital bridge between graduates, employers, departments, and university services.

heroSlides.title: Connecting ASTU's Excellence to the Global Industry
heroSlides.description: A unified gateway for alumni, employers, and departments to foster professional growth, talent acquisition, and academic innovation at Adama Science and Technology University. Join 1,238+ alumni already connected.

heroSlides.title: Empowering ASTU Graduates in Modern Workspaces
heroSlides.description: Discover corporate partners, publish practical career openings, and track your employment outcomes. Building bridges between classroom theory and real-world placement across 5 fields of study.

heroSlides.title: Coordinating Strategic Tracer Studies & Skill Gaps
heroSlides.description: Enabling department heads and partner companies to identify technological skill gaps directly from the workforce, securing university accreditation outcomes.

portals.title: Alumni
points: Create and maintain your professional profile.
Access verified job listings and internship opportunities.
Complete tracer surveys to guide curriculum development.
Mentor current students and connect with peers.

portals.title: Employers
points: Post employment opportunities for ASTU graduates.
Search alumni by expertise, skills, and department.
Provide feedback to enhance curriculum relevance.

portals.title: Departments
points: Monitor graduate employment outcomes and metrics.
Identify skill gaps through employer analytics.

portals.title: Registrar
points: Validate alumni credentials against SIS records.
Send tracer study reminders and audit notifications.

portals.title: Administrator
points: Manage users, roles, and department records.
Monitor system logs, backups, and security protocols.
Oversee institutional analytics and accreditation reports.

testimonials.quote: ASTU-AMS gave our department the evidence we needed for skill-gap review.
The candidate search and feedback tools improved our campus recruitment cycle.
I found mentorship, events, and job matches without leaving the alumni portal.

faq.question: Who can use ASTU-AMS?
faq.answer: Verified alumni, employers, registrar teams, departments, and system administrators each access role-specific services.

faq.question: How are tracer studies used?
faq.answer: Responses support employment analytics, skill-gap reviews, curriculum updates, and accreditation evidence.

faq.question: Can employers register events?
faq.answer: Employer partners can coordinate job posts, internships, campus recruitment events, interviews, and feedback reports.

faq.question: How do I request a transcript?
faq.answer: Log into your alumni profile, navigate to "Document Requests", and submit a digital request through the Registrar portal.

faq.question: What is the Tracer Study?
faq.answer: A longitudinal survey that tracks graduate employment outcomes at 6, 12, and 24-month intervals for accreditation.

tracerSpotlight.title: Tracer Study 2026
tracerSpotlight.description: Help ASTU maintain accreditation by completing your career outcome survey. Your responses drive curriculum updates and institutional quality assurance.
